project: Project 2 - Opportunity Registry and Pathway Platform

industry_opportunities.note: Same parameters and values as /api/projects. Industry opportunities have no student level or term, so level or term leaves none.

query_parameter_values.area: One research area name exactly as listed, case-insensitive, e.g. Artificial Intelligence.
query_parameter_values.level: undergraduate | graduate (projects marked 'Undergraduate or Graduate' match both)
query_parameter_values.term: A term as stored, e.g. Winter 2027 (case-insensitive)
query_parameter_values.facultyId: A faculty member's id (same id as /api/faculty/{id}); for industry opportunities, matches a supervising faculty member
query_parameter_values.q: Free text, case-insensitive substring; % and _ are matched literally

filter_semantics: All given parameters must match (AND). An area matches if it is any one of the record's areas. Unknown values return HTTP 400 with an error message. Each directory response also includes a 'filters' object listing the available choices with counts, computed from what the viewer may see.

request_body.title: required
request_body.researchAreas: optional array of research area names

partner_intake.success: HTTP 201 { submission: { id, title, state: { value: 'awaiting_supervisor', label: 'Awaiting faculty supervisor' } } }
partner_intake.rejection: HTTP 400 { error, errors: [{ field, message }] }; nothing is stored (R2-04)
partner_intake.note: Any other fields in the body (state, ids, supervisors) are ignored (R2-03).

faculty_opportunity_views.who: verified faculty and staff (others: 401 signed out, 403 signed in)

fields.state: state.value: awaiting_supervisor | supervised; state.label: 'Awaiting faculty supervisor' (R2-08)
fields.partner_contact: contact.name, contact.email (R2-05: faculty and staff views only)

willingness_actions.who: verified faculty only, always acting as the signed-in user (R2-24)
willingness_actions.preconditions: the faculty member has made the R1 public-display choice and has a faculty profile; otherwise HTTP 409 with code public_profile_choice_required or faculty_profile_required
willingness_actions.effect: First willing supervisor makes the opportunity student-visible (R2-07); any number may record willingness (R2-09); withdrawing removes only the caller, and it leaves student discovery only when none remain (R2-10).

engagement_action.effect: Records the state and the caller as the one who recorded it (R2-12, R2-13). Locks nothing (R2-14). Never in student or public responses (R2-15).

subscription_settings.request_body: { "mode": "none" | "all" | "areas", "researchAreas": [area names, required when mode is areas] }
subscription_settings.note: Private (R2-17). Changes apply to submissions created afterwards (R2-20).

notifications.how_to_observe: Submit at /partner.html with area Human-Computer Interaction, then sign in as fixture-f-priya@algomau.ca and open Notifications. fixture-f-mei@algomau.ca subscribes to nothing and is never notified, but sees every opportunity at /submissions.html (R2-19).

student_discovery.page_route: /projects.html (faculty and industry projects in one list; page-only filter 'type' = faculty | industry)
student_discovery.supervisors_field: supervisors[] with id and displayName, linking to /faculty.html?id={id} (R2-22)
student_discovery.contact_field: supervisors[].contact.email on the detail endpoint: a supervising faculty member, never the partner (R2-23)
student_discovery.never_included: partner contact name and email, capacity, engagement state or who is engaging (R2-05, R2-15)

public_surfaces: GET /api/faculty and /faculty.html: verified faculty who allowed public display
GET /api/faculty/{id} and /faculty.html?id={id}: the same faculty only
GET /api/projects and /projects.html: published projects of those faculty
GET /api/projects/{id} and /projects.html?id={id}: the same projects only
GET /api/opportunities and /opportunity.html?id={id}: industry opportunities with at least one supervisor who allowed public display; only those supervisors are named
/partner.html and POST /api/partner-submissions: the accountless intake form
authenticated_only_surfaces: The faculty, project and opportunity surfaces above, signed in, additionally include verified faculty who declined public display, their published projects, and opportunities they supervise
/submissions.html and /api/partner-submissions/*: verified faculty and staff only
/notifications.html, /api/notifications and /api/notifications/subscriptions: verified faculty only, own data only
hidden_response: Records the viewer may not see (drafts, closed or withdrawn projects, opportunities awaiting a supervisor, signed-in-only records when logged out, unverified or revoked faculty) return HTTP 404, identical to a missing record.

authentication.method: Passwordless 6-digit code, restricted to @algomau.ca; session is an httpOnly cookie
authentication.read_code_in_test_mode: GET /api/auth/pending-challenges (also /operator.html), for test accounts only, with a signed-in staff session or the X-Operator-Secret header. The operator access code is shared privately, never in this repository.

fixture_loading: Migrations 003 and 004, then npm run seed:fixture (from project2/backend), or npm run seed:fixture:sql pasted into the Supabase SQL Editor. Loads the R1 fixture and the R2 fixtures; S-204 is rejected by the same validation as the public form.
